rival_explanations: The pole is a generic lowercase word-start detector in every register: the scan's full-strength prose peaks ('c'oral, ' more', ' d'rape, ' p'endant, 'o' Caradog, ' b'ongo at 2.2-2.8) are the same job, so ordinary lowercase words mid-sentence in flowing prose should also fire near peak strength rather than stay at or below the activity line.

The pole fires on a learned set of lowercase infrastructure nouns it has seen as identifiers (data, test, email, object, event, context, session, buffer) rather than on the word-start form, so an unseen lowercase identifier ('quux', 'frobnicate') or a rare lowercase name should fire weakly, and its strength should follow the token's identity rather than its lowercase position.
